summary: Iter-5 testing of (a) admin KYC Hold-with-comment + merchant resubmit, (b) Twilio inbound webhook, (c) /admin/stores merchant snapshot enrichment, (d) merchant multi-image product upload, (e) AdminPanel JSX compile fix. Backend: 14/14 pytest pass (test_iter5_flow.py) covering all listed endpoints. Frontend: AdminPanel.jsx now compiles and renders (no React syntax crash), 'On hold' option present in Approvals status dropdown — BUT a CRITICAL runtime-error overlay ('Failed to execute json on Response: body stream already read') blocks every admin interaction (KYC modal Hold flow, Stores tab DocPreview, Approvals load). RCA: backend /api/admin/change-requests function in server.py (line ~807-809) is MISSING the @api.get decorator → 404 → AdminPanel.jsx Promise.all at line 106-109 then calls r.json() twice on the failed Response. Merchant onboarding /merchant/onboarding hold UI and multi-image upload UI could not be visually validated because admin approval pipeline is unreachable while the overlay is up, but their backend contracts pass.

critical.issue: Handler `async def admin_change_requests` in server.py ~line 807 has NO @api.get decorator. Endpoint returns 404 in production, breaking AdminPanel Approvals load() which expects this JSON to render Bank/Address change requests AND triggers a runtime-error overlay in the entire admin UI. Add `@api.get("/admin/change-requests")` decorator immediately above the function.

minor.issue: Webhook accepts any sender phone because RIDER_PHONE is unset in this preview (per task brief). Before production, set RIDER_PHONE env var so random WhatsApp users can't mark orders delivered.
Returns full base64 PAN/GST/cheque docs in every list call — payload grows with merchant count. Consider lazy-loading docs from a /api/admin/merchants/{mid}/docs endpoint.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime error overlay 'Failed to execute json on Response: body stream already read' covers entire admin UI on every admin route. Caused by /admin/change-requests returning 404 (see backend critical) — Promise.all branch calls .json() on a Response whose body was already consumed by apiFetch error handler. Fix backend route AND/OR guard with .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : []).catch(()=>[]) inside Promise.all so a single failing fetch doesn't crash the page.

KYC button text ('Approve', 'Reject') is rendered in DOM but the body-stream-read overlay intercepts pointer events. action_items: BACKEND (CRITICAL): Add `@api.get("/admin/change-requests")` decorator above admin_change_requests in /app/backend/server.py around line 807 — endpoint is currently unrouted (404).

FRONTEND (CRITICAL): In /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.jsx lines 106-109, wrap each .then((r) => r.json()) with `.then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : []).catch(() => [])` so a single failing endpoint doesn't break the whole admin page and trigger the body-stream-already-read overlay.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:807-809 — admin_change_requests is undecorated. This is a regression from prior iterations where the same handler was reachable. Either restore the decorator or remove the handler.

AdminPanel.jsx:106-109 — Promise.all chain calls .then((r) => r.json()) with no error guard. Any single 4xx/5xx response will surface as 'body stream already read' because apiFetch likely already consumed the body. Switch to per-promise try/catch or guard with `r.ok ? r.json() : fallback`.

server.py is now 1293 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Split into routers (auth/admin/merchant/customer/twilio/geo) to make missing-decorator regressions like the one above harder to introduce.

ProductCreate.images: List[str] has no per-image size cap. With 5 images × ~6 MB base64 dataURLs, a single POST/PUT can exceed typical 30 MB upload budgets and bloat every /api/products list response. Consider storing images in GridFS / object storage and persisting only URLs on the product doc.

rca of the issue: Symptom: After admin login, full-screen red 'Uncaught runtime errors: Failed to execute json on Response: body stream already read' overlay blocks every click. RCA: /app/backend/server.py defines `async def admin_change_requests(...)` at ~line 807 but the `@api.get("/admin/change-requests")` decorator was lost in a prior edit. The endpoint now returns 404. /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.jsx ApprovalsTab.load() runs `Promise.all([fetch('/admin/merchants?...').then(r=>r.json()), fetch('/admin/change-requests...').then(r=>r.json())])`. apiFetch likely reads the body of the 404 response once for error logging, then the .then(r=>r.json()) tries to read it again → 'body stream already read'. Mitigation: (a) restore decorator on backend handler, (b) defensively wrap each promise with r.ok ? r.json() : [].
